title: Traffic Signal - Knockdown - TRN
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a traffic signal, school zone flasher, or traffic signal control box that has been hit or knocked down completely to where the damage causes a signal malfunction. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.
